about_the_game:
A rain of red meteors lit up the atmosphere like sparks dancing in the dark. They fell across the entire planet — in forests, mountains, deserts, and oceans — without causing major destruction.

Humanity simply watched, fascinated.

It seemed harmless.

But it wasn’t.

Inside each fragment there was an unknown energy, something alive yet dormant.

Little by little, this energy began to spread across the Earth, silent like a fever no one could notice.

Days later, the first cases appeared.

Zombies began showing up everywhere.

However, when four women came into contact with this energy, they weren’t transformed — instead, they awakened the ability to manipulate the elements.

And the four heroines joined together to fight the zombies.

And from this awakening arose the Fire of Life.

They became the Flameborn Heroines.

Summary

Destroy meteor fragments, defeat hordes of zombies in this third-person adventure game featuring magic, combat, and character selection.

Face waves of zombies and mutant bosses in intense, strategic battles.
